greet.speaker: yev
greet.text: The grove felt you go down the throat. The whole Weft flinched, and then it sang, and the Rootched sent me to find out what a Weaver is. I am Yev. I keep the grove. I did, until they started cutting from it. I would like to walk with the flinch.

choices.text: [Rootkin] I know the grove. It sang to me as a child.

cutting.speaker: yev
cutting.text: Cuttings. Living Weft, taken to grow somewhere else. My faction calls it completion. I call it a wound. Take me with you. I can find where the cuttings went, and I will not pretend I do not want to know.

choices.text: Walk with us. We will find your cuttings.
Kaj, she sees the Weft the way you hear the signal. Thoughts?

kaj_call.speaker: kaj7
kaj_call.text: She listened to me without correcting me. Nobody has done that since you. Yes.

refused.speaker: yev
refused.text: The current brought you back. It does that.

loyalty.speaker: yev
loyalty.text: The heart-cutting. The first one they took, the one the rest grew from. I know where it is now. I would like to go and decide what it is for, and I would like you to not decide for me.

recruited.speaker: yev
recruited.text: Your Bastion has roots under the plaza. Old ones. They are listening to the Beacon.

choices.text: Do they like what they hear?

roots.speaker: yev
roots.text: They have not decided. Roots are slow. So am I.
